sn17.4:1.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dīghalomikā eḷakā kaṇṭakāgahaṇaṃ paviseyya,
sn17.4:1.4: sā tatra tatra sajjeyya, tatra tatra gayheyya, tatra tatra bajjheyya, tatra tatra anayavyasanaṃ āpajjeyya.
sn17.4:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati.
sn17.4:1.6: so tatra tatra sajjati, tatra tatra gayhati. tatra tatra bajjhati, tatra tatra anayavyasanaṃ āpajjati.
sn17.4:1.8: [uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma …pe… ]evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti.
